newsitem.title: USA: IPL says crude oil lines 3 and 2b restarted.
newsitem.headline: IPL says crude oil lines 3 and 2b restarted.

text.p: Interprovincial Pipe Line Inc said Tuesday that two of its downed crude pipelines had restarted after power was restored to pumping stations in weather-hit Minnesota.

Severe snowstorms had cut power in northern Minnesota last Saturday night, which closed three key pumping stations on the IPL system and reduced throughput on Canada's main pipeline to the United States by a million barrels a day.

"Power crews able to access Plummer station early this morning and were able to restart line three at about 2.30 (0430 EDT/0930 GMT) and line 2b at about 4.20 (0620 EDT/1120 GMT). These lines are pumping at a very low rate due to a limited power grid," a spokesman said.
The power outage had shut line 13 also and other lines were hit by the knock-on effect as inventories ran out.

Line two runs 1,098 miles from Edmonton, capital of Canada's Alberta province to Superior, Wisconsin and carries light, medium and synthetic crudes plus condensate. Line three also runs from Edmonton to Superior and carries light, medium, heavy and synthetic crudes plus condensate.
Line 13 runs 800 miles from Hardisty, Alberta (downstream from Edmonton) to Clearbrook, Minn. and carries light crude.
IPL said it will resume work to get the other two pumping stations at Vicking and Clearbrook going and will report progress later on Tuesday.
